stepsOfService.intro: San Fermo runs 85 seats (57 indoor + 28 patio), 5pm–10pm, three turns a night (T1 5–7, T2 7–9, T3 9–close). The menu is small and changes daily — the chef asks that each table puts its whole order in at once.

steps.title: Greet within 2 minutes
steps.detail: Welcome the table, offer water (still or sparkling), and set the menu format: a small menu that changes daily, and the chef asks for the whole order at once.

steps.title: Drinks
steps.detail: Take the cocktail and wine order. Guide by-the-glass, mention what's notable tonight, and flag anything 86'd before they decide.

steps.title: Full food order at once
steps.detail: Per the chef's request, take the entire food order in one pass. Note allergies and call out raw / under-cooked items (marked * on the menu).

steps.title: Fire & pace
steps.detail: Coordinate firing and pacing with expo. Read the table — match the pace to their turn so the next seating lands clean.

steps.title: Mark & maintain
steps.detail: Mark the table for each course, crumb between courses, keep water and wine topped, and reset silver as needed.

steps.title: Check back
steps.detail: Quality check two bites into each course. Catch problems early, never at the end.

steps.title: Dessert & digestivi
steps.detail: Offer dessert, then the after-dinner list — amaro flights, grappa, port, and the digestivi selection.

steps.title: Present the check
steps.detail: If asked about the 23% service charge: it replaces tipping, 100% goes to the house, and no additional tip is expected.

steps.title: Reset
steps.detail: Reset the table promptly and cleanly for the next turn.

standards.title: Service charge
standards.body: We've eliminated tipping. A 23% service fee applies to food and beverage; 100% goes to the house. Deliver this plainly and confidently if a guest asks — it's the model, not an apology.

standards.title: Wine service
standards.body: Present the bottle to the host, pour a taste, then pour clockwise around the table, women first where it reads naturally, host last. Whites and bubbles in the chiller; reds at cellar temp. Top thoughtfully — don't empty the bottle without offering another.

standards.title: Allergies & raw items
standards.body: Items marked * are served raw or under-cooked. Always surface allergies to the kitchen at order, and repeat them on the ticket. When in doubt, ask the chef — never guess.

board.note: Pre-service board. Update the 86 list and tonight's specials at the start of each shift — keep it current so the floor and the kitchen read the same thing.
